# TweenUtil

> TweenService presets and promise-based tweens.

- Package: `TweenUtil` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Promise](Promise.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("TweenUtil")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("TweenUtil")` (shared/client keys)

## `Gaxia.TweenUtil`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/TweenUtil.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local TweenUtil = Gaxia.TweenUtil
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local TweenUtil = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.TweenUtil)
```

### Functions

- `TweenUtil.Create(instance: Instance, infoOrTable: TweenInfoLike, props: { [string]: any }): Tween`
- `TweenUtil.Play(instance: Instance, infoOrTable: TweenInfoLike, props: { [string]: any }): Tween`
- `TweenUtil.PlayAsync(instance: Instance, infoOrTable: TweenInfoLike, props: { [string]: any }): PromiseTypes.Promise<Enum.PlaybackState>`
  Returns a Promise that resolves with the tween's final PlaybackState (Completed, or Cancelled if the tween was cancelled) when it ends.
- `TweenUtil.Chain(steps: { ChainStep }): PromiseTypes.Promise<boolean>`
  Sequentially play a list of tween steps. Returns a Promise resolving (true) when the last step ends.
